_comment: Illustrative catalogue used by MockTrivyAdapter. Entries follow Trivy's JSON schema v2 vulnerability shape.

vulnerabilities.Title: zlib: integer overflow and resultant heap-based buffer overflow in zipOpenNewFileInZip4_6
vulnerabilities.Description: MiniZip in zlib through 1.3 has an integer overflow and resultant heap-based buffer overflow via a long filename, comment, or extra field.

vulnerabilities.Title: glibc: buffer overflow in ld.so leading to privilege escalation
vulnerabilities.Description: A buffer overflow was discovered in the GNU C Library's dynamic loader ld.so while processing the GLIBC_TUNABLES environment variable.

vulnerabilities.Title: openssh: regreSSHion - race condition in signal handler
vulnerabilities.Description: A signal handler race condition was found in OpenSSH's server (sshd), where a client does not authenticate within LoginGraceTime seconds.

vulnerabilities.Title: curl: heap based buffer overflow in the SOCKS5 proxy handshake
vulnerabilities.Description: This flaw makes curl overflow a heap based buffer in the SOCKS5 proxy handshake.

vulnerabilities.Title: ncurses: segmentation fault via _nc_wrap_entry()
vulnerabilities.Description: NCurse v6.4-20230418 was discovered to contain a segmentation fault via the component _nc_wrap_entry().

vulnerabilities.Title: glibc: out of bounds write in iconv may lead to remote code execution
vulnerabilities.Description: The iconv() function in the GNU C Library may overflow the output buffer passed to it when converting strings to the ISO-2022-CN-EXT character set.

vulnerabilities.Title: binutils: libiberty/rust-demangle.c stack exhaustion in demangle_const
vulnerabilities.Description: libiberty/rust-demangle.c in GNU GCC 11.2 allows stack exhaustion in demangle_const.

vulnerabilities.Title: apt: weak key verification in apt-key
vulnerabilities.Description: It was found that apt-key in apt does not correctly validate gpg keys with the master keyring.

vulnerabilities.Title: [Privilege escalation possible to other user than root]
pypa-setuptools: Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) in package_index.py
vulnerabilities.Description: Python Packaging Authority (PyPA) setuptools before 65.5.1 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service via HTML in a crafted package or custom PackageIndex page.

vulnerabilities.Title: pip: Mercurial configuration injectable in repo revision when installing via pip
vulnerabilities.Description: When installing a package from a Mercurial VCS URL with pip prior to v23.3, the specified Mercurial revision could be used to inject arbitrary configuration options.

vulnerabilities.Title: requests: subsequent requests to the same host ignore cert verification
vulnerabilities.Description: When making requests through a Requests Session, if the first request is made with verify=False to disable cert verification, all subsequent requests to the same host will continue to ignore cert verification.

vulnerabilities.Title: python-gunicorn: HTTP Request Smuggling due to improper validation of Transfer-Encoding headers
vulnerabilities.Description: Gunicorn fails to properly validate Transfer-Encoding headers, leading to HTTP Request Smuggling (HRS) vulnerabilities.

vulnerabilities.Title: PyYAML: incomplete fix for CVE-2020-1747
vulnerabilities.Description: A vulnerability was discovered in the PyYAML library in versions before 5.4, where it is susceptible to arbitrary code execution when it processes untrusted YAML files through the full_load method or with the FullLoader loader.
